schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to query. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

selector.description: Optional dir:<path> or file:<path> scope; the whole repository when absent.

format.description: summary (counts and the highest-symbol files, default) or full (every in-scope file with its symbols).

limit.description: Cap on each result array, nested ones included (files and the lists inside their entries); 1-500, default 50. Cut arrays are reported in truncation.
